title: Play Creates the World

publication.scope: public world-law, public artwork provenance, and device-local candidate play

ingress_equivalence.note: The owner-supplied ingress and canonical public PNG have identical pixels but different byte encodings. The existing canonical public bytes are reused.

roles.player: acts, chooses, and explicitly keeps a candidate trace
roles.knight: inherits prior traces and continues the thread
roles.model: interprets or performs proposals; never owns canonical truth
roles.skein: preserves canonical evidence, provenance, and accepted story state
roles.saedo: owns durable work and its acceptance record
roles.guardian: authorizes or rejects real-world side effects

thread_event.append_rule: accepted events append; prior accepted evidence is not rewritten
thread_event.inheritance_rule: an inherited event cites every accepted parent it continues
thread_event.side_effect_rule: real-world actions require a Guardian decision recorded in provenance

invariants: durable work has a Saedo acceptance record
model output remains a proposal until explicitly accepted
history is extended or superseded, never silently erased
public story traces contain no secret, private UI, credential, or local-path material
